blurb: Beal & Bunker operates ferry services with scheduled trips and special boat charters to the Cranberry Isles. They transport passengers, freight, and vehicles including bicycles and kayaks. Their boats have indoor seating with heat and removable windows, and a head on board.
extraNote: Commuter pass cannot be used for freight or charters · Increased rates between 8pm & 6am for special boat charters · Passengers should limit freight during peak summer weekends and holidays · Gasoline cans filled with gas are not permitted on ferry · Containers of propane or LNG allowed if DOT/ICC approved, max 20 pounds, captain notified, stowed properly · Northeast Harbor Visitor Center (for ticket sales) · Spring schedule: 2nd Monday of May to 2nd week of June; Summer schedule: 3rd Monday of June to Sunday before Labor Day; Fall schedule: Labor Day to 2nd week of October; Winter schedule: 2nd Monday of October to 2nd Monday of May
